submission_method.quote:

contract_term.quote: Olds College will enter a contract for services for five (5) years. There will also be the opportunity to renew the contract for two (2) separate three (3) years renewals, based solely on the College’s discretion.

scope_of_deliverables.quote:
SCOPE OF WORK

Detailed LMS System Requirements
Functional Requirements - Student Experience and Quality Instruction

#1 Development & Management of Learning Content
● Contains a course organizational structure and ability to manage courses (e.g. templates)
○ Ability to copy course templates and share internally
○ Ability to copy course content from one course to another
● Ability to develop course learning materials in the system
○ Access to a repository of learning documents and tools
○ Authoring tools for developing content within the LMS - presentations, videos, discussion boards, etc.
○ Ability to easily link media in courses
● Ability to incorporate existing content into the system
○ Supports integration and use of Google Drive and Documents
● Ensures calendar functionality (including ease of integration with various external calendars) for individual students’ comprehensive activities and milestones
● Supports integration of external learning content (eg. digital textbooks such as Vital Source, McGraw-Hill)
● Directly supports H5P
#2 Assessment
● Ability to develop and manage gradebooks in an efficient manner
○ Weighted grading, outcome-based rubrics, etc.
● Student access to grade information
● Access to a variety of assessment templates and tools
○ Ability to build various types of quiz questions to measure knowledge and skills in various ways, including interactive questions types.
● Ability to develop assessment tools
● Ability for students to submit work in multiple formats via the system
○ E.g. Written documents, videos, pictures
● Ability for instructors to provide timely formative and summative feedback
scope_of_deliverables.value: Development and management of learning content, assessment capabilities, and integration with external learning content and tools.

pricing_structure.quote: Proponents shall submit pricing in their Proposal, as requested in Schedule D - Scope of Work and Pricing Schedule, as follows: ●​ in Canadian dollars, and ●​ Prices must remain fixed and applicable to all goods and services, as detailed within this RFP, throughout the entire term of the 5 year agreement.
